notes: «وحدثنيه صاحب، لي عنه» is a second route of the same saying (rule 4): an unnamed companion, then «عنه» pointing back to عقبة
The names between سليمان and the unnamed companion are not repeated in the second route: written as the text gives them
«- وأنا لحديث، صاحبي أحفظ -» is the narrator's gloss (left out)
